symptom: `mxcli playwright check` (and the login of `run --page-check`/`--screenshot-user`) failed with "node not found; the page check needs the Node that Playwright uses" on a machine with no system node whose newest cached mxbuild is 11.15, although mxbuild 11.15 ships tools/node/<platform>/node
cause: resolveNodeForScript found mxbuild's bundled node through resolveNodeTooling, which also requires tools/node/rollup-runner.mjs; mxbuild 11.15 dropped the rollup runner (rspack only), so the lookup failed before it looked for the node binary
fix: look up the node binary directly with findNodeBinary(<modeler>/tools/node) instead of going through the rollup-runner check
insight: a helper that validates a whole toolchain was reused to find one binary in it; when the platform dropped an unrelated piece of that toolchain the reuse broke a caller that never needed it. Found by a smoke test on a machine whose newest mxbuild was 11.15, not by unit tests, which put node on PATH
test: cmd/mxcli/docker/screenshot_login_node_test.go TestResolveNodeForScript_RspackOnlyMxBuild (PATH emptied, 11.15 tools/node layout; fails with the old lookup)
